1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for opposite party no.2 as well as
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed for quashing the charge-sheet dated 06.07.2018 filed in
Case Crime No.256 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 I.P.C. and 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station
Mahanagar, District Lucknow as well as summoning order dated 15.12.2018 passed by Additional
Chief Judicial Magistrate C.B.I. (Ap), Lucknow in Criminal Case No.69508 of 2018 (State Vs. Brijesh
Kumar & Others).

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicants submit that both the parties have amicably compromised their dispute.
The compromise which has taken place between the parties is also filed before this Court as Brijesh Kumar @ Brijesh Kumar Gupta And ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ...

sentences.text:
on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55411154/
1 Annexure No.4 to the application.

4. Whether the parties have, in fact, compromised the matter or not, can best be ascertained by the trial court concerned as such compromise has to be duly verified in presence of the parties concerned before the Court.

5. Accordingly, this application is disposed of with a direction to the trial court concerned that if any such compromise is filed before it, it shall issue notices to all the signatories to the compromise requiring their personal presence and, thereafter, proceed to verify the compromise.

If the aforesaid compromise is verified, a report to that effect shall be prepared by the court and the compromise will be made part of the record.
6.

The court concerned in that scenario will allow the parties to obtain certified copy of the report as well as compromise and it will be open to the applicants to approach this Court again for quashing of the proceedings.
7. For a period of one month, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
8. Office is directed to return the original compromise deed to the learned counsel for the applicants, after taking the photocopy of the same.
